name: Xiao Baitu Dianshang
source:
Decades ago, monsters and humans established trade relations.
With the influx of human technology and capital, the monster world embarked on a modernization process.
Industries flourished, and a large number of low-end industries also shifted from the human world to this side.
The monsters' lives underwent enormous changes. They acquired human civilization, learned human technology, yearned for human society, and wanted to live as prosperous a life as humans. Each monster believed that as long as they worked hard, they could earn a lot of money because opportunities were everywhere.
At first, this was indeed the case, and many monsters got rich overnight.
- - Until humans launched a trade war.
Humans accused monsters of producing low-priced products that affected their own market and employment, and accused monsters of stealing human technology patents. As a result, humans began comprehensive trade sanctions. Then, the monster world's economy was severely hit, and many monsters went bankrupt or lost their jobs.
But in this magical era, an inconspicuous rabbit fairy secretly opened an online store selling the carrots she grew! And as her helper, you must work with her to manage the shop and make it grow. Make the business more prosperous, face various crises, and then uncover the secrets hidden in various corners of the world!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
数十年前，妖怪与人类建立了贸易关系。
随着人类的技术与资本涌入，妖怪世界也踏上了现代化的道路。
各行各业蓬勃发展，大量低端产业也从人类世界转移到了这里。
妖怪们的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。他们接受人类文明，学习人类技术，向往人类社会，也想过上与人类同样富裕的日子。每个妖怪都相信，只要努力，就能赚大钱，因为遍地都是机会。
起初，确实如此，许多妖怪一夜暴富。
——直到人类发动贸易战。
人类指责妖怪生产廉价商品，冲击自己的市场与就业，又指责妖怪窃取人类的技术专利。于是，全面贸易制裁开始了。妖怪世界的经济遭受重创，许多妖怪破产、失业。
可就在这个魔幻的时代，一只不起眼的兔子妖怪，悄悄开了家网店，卖起自己种的胡萝卜！作为她的帮手，你必须与她一起经营店铺，让生意越做越大，应对各种危机，最终揭开隐藏在世界各个角落的秘密！
